evidence.observation: The exhaust O2 sensor is listed as not installed, but the growth stage requires it to verify the atmosphere.
The ramp tracked setpoint closely. At growth start the reading was 760.4 against a 750 setpoint (about 10 °C high), then settled to 749.8 by t=2760.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint.
Pressure is steady at about 760 Torr. At atmospheric pressure the gauge would not show an air leak into the tube.
Heater power is 39–44% during growth, which fits holding steady at temperature.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or another independent check of the atmosphere, such as a leak check) is needed to rule out air getting into the tube. Characterization of the sample is not yet available.
